sum: This paper proposes the "Bulk Viscous Resistance Principle" to resolve the discrepancy between low geodynamically inferred lithosphere-asthenosphere system resistance (0.01–0.03) and high laboratory rock friction (0.6–0.85). The framework divides plate resistance into rate-dependent viscous drag at the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) and rate-independent brittle friction at trenches. By deriving an analytical framework from diffusion creep laws, the author shows that a purely solid mantle cannot explain the ultra-low resistance. Instead, it requires melt-assisted diffusion creep distributed across an equivalent thickness of 10–100 km, matching the global asthenospheric low-velocity zone (LVZ). This unified physical framework successfully reconciles geodynamic observations with mineral physics.
本文提出了“体粘性阻力原理”，以解决地球动力学反演的超低岩石圈-软流圈系统阻力（0.01-0.03）与实验室岩石摩擦系数（0.6-0.85）之间的矛盾。该框架将板块阻力划分为岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）处的速率相关粘性拖拽和俯冲带处的速率无关脆性摩擦。基于扩散蠕变本构方程，本文推导了体粘性阻力系数的……

t: Analytical derivation of the bulk viscous resistance coefficient based on the diffusion creep constitutive law and three hierarchical sub-mechanisms.
基于扩散蠕变本构关系和三个层级子机制，解析推导了体粘性阻力系数。
Representative mineral physics parameters for diffusion creep under pure solid and melt-bearing mantle conditions, compared against geodynamic inversion constraints.
纯固体和含熔体地幔条件下扩散蠕变的代表性矿物物理参数，并与地球动力学反演约束进行对比。
A purely solid mantle requires unrealistic creep thickness to match geodynamic resistance, whereas melt-assisted diffusion creep yields matching resistance with an equivalent thickness of 10–100 km.
纯固体地幔需要极端的蠕变厚度，而熔体辅助扩散蠕变在10-100千米等效厚度下即可匹配动力学阻力。
Simplified representation of transient water absorption in subduction zones and reliance on 1D analytical approximations of complex 3D mantle flow.
简化了俯冲带中瞬态水分吸收的过程，且依赖于复杂三维地幔流的一维解析近似。
Proposes a unified physical framework reconciling geodynamic and laboratory resistance discrepancies by shifting focus from localized LAB shear to distributed asthenospheric creep.
提出统一物理框架，通过将关注点从局部LAB剪切转向分布式软流圈蠕变，调和了动力学与实验室阻力差异。

sum: This Zenodo dataset supports a study on monitoring Earth's tidal response on the deep seafloor using fiber-optic sensing. It contains three main components: (1) predicted solid-Earth tide (SET) and ocean tide loading (OTL) horizontal strain rate time series (east, north, northeast) computed using FES2004 and Wahr's theory; (2) preprocessed Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) strain rate data, including highpass filtered versions and datasets with/without common-mode noise removal; and (3) interpolated cable coordinates (longitude, latitude, bathymetry, and azimuth). This dataset enables the validation of deep-ocean tidal models and demonstrates the utility of seafloor telecommunication cables for large-scale geophysical monitoring of deformation processes.
该数据集支持利用光纤传感监测深海海底潮汐响应。内容包括：基于FES2004和Wahr理论计算的固体潮与海洋潮汐负荷水平应变率预测时序；预处理后的分布式声学传感（DAS）应变率数据（含高通滤波及去共模噪声版本）；以及光缆轨迹坐标与水深。该数据有助于验证深海潮汐模型，展示了海底光缆进行大规模地球物理形变……

sum: This study investigates the 2025 Santorini-Amorgos seismic crisis in Greece using a machine-learning-based earthquake monitoring workflow. By detecting and relocating 66,109 earthquakes, the authors map a southeast-dipping normal-fault network at 8–12 km depth. The sequence propagated 30 km in 19 days, punctuated by 46 episodic, hour-long seismicity bursts migrating up to 3 km/hr. Some bursts exhibit migrating back-fronts indicative of stress shadows from dike opening. The high earthquake productivity, rapid migration, and emergence of long-period events suggest a deep magmatic intrusion that stalled without shallow hydrothermal activation. This work highlights the power of ML-based workflows in tracking complex, fluid-driven seismic sequences in real-time.
本研究利用机器学习对2025年希腊圣托里尼地震危机进行重定位，获取超6万个地震。结果揭示了深8-12 km的正断层，序列在19天内传播30 km，伴随46次高速迁移的幕式爆发。部分爆发具有岩脉张开导致的应力影区特征。极高的地震生产力与快速迁移表明该过程由深部岩浆侵入驱动。

sum: This study presents a detailed energy analysis approach for structures equipped with vibration absorbers under seismic excitation. Instead of traditional relative coordinates and ground acceleration, the author proposes an alternative mathematical model using absolute coordinates, ground displacement, and ground velocity. This formulation provides clearer insights into the structural energy content and the influence of absorbers on stiffness. The performance of a linear tuned mass damper (TMD) and a nonlinear energy sink (NES) is evaluated using a 9-story structure subjected to three historic earthquake records (Kobe, El Centro, and Northridge). Results show that both absorbers facilitate energy transfer from the ground to the structure, with the TMD transferring more energy during the Kobe earthquake, while the NES outperforms the TMD under El Centro and Northridge excitations, demonstrating the utility of energy-based structural assessment.

sum: This study presents new in situ major and trace element data from highly serpentinized peridotites drilled at ODP Hole 1277A on the Newfoundland margin. Despite intense serpentinization, relict minerals preserve evidence of high degrees of melt extraction (≥14%) initiated in the garnet stability field, predating Jurassic rifting. The mantle section experienced subsequent melt-rock interaction, lithospheric-scale shear zone deformation, and hydration/serpentinization during exhumation. The findings demonstrate that the pre-rift history and refractory nature of the lithospheric mantle play a primary role in governing the structural and magmatic evolution of magma-poor conjugate rifted margins.

sum: This paper reviews the statistical treatment of in situ ocean observations from profiling floats (Argo) and surface drifters (Global Drifter Program). It describes recent spatio-temporal models developed to address the challenges of sparse and irregular sampling in physical oceanography. The authors discuss Eulerian and Lagrangian reference frames, explaining their suitability for profiling floats and surface drifters, respectively, to guide future statistical modeling and oceanographic forecasting.

sum: This paper introduces a multiscale self-attention summary network designed for subsurface velocity-model building. Common-image gathers (CIGs) contain critical velocity error information but are high-dimensional and sensitive to background-velocity mismatch. The proposed network maps 3D CIG volumes into compact, low-dimensional conditioning embeddings that preserve kinematic structures and spatial coherence. These summary embeddings condition a generative flow-matching model, which maps a Gaussian distribution to the posterior distribution of velocity fields. Numerical experiments demonstrate that this multiscale attention summary network significantly improves posterior velocity inference compared to direct conditioning on raw CIGs. It provides greater robustness to background-model mismatch, resulting in more accurate velocity reconstructions and reduced predictive uncertainty.

sum: This study utilizes continuous seismic data from 2014 to 2022 along the Xianshuihe fault zone (XSHF) to investigate its kinematic and mechanical heterogeneity. By employing machine learning for earthquake detection, the authors cataloged 12,534 events and inverted for a regional 3D crustal velocity model. Integrating these with a GNSS-derived fault locking model, they analyzed spatiotemporal seismicity patterns and b-value variations. The results reveal pronounced segmentation along the northern XSHF, with two primary locked zones north of Bamei and complex stress loading in the Bamei–Kangding releasing bend. The study highlights that the northern XSHF is progressively entering a locked state with potential for Mw 6.8+ earthquakes, demonstrating how integrating high-resolution seismicity, velocity models, and geodetic locking constraints can clarify deformation and seismic hazards in major intracontinental strike-slip systems.

sum: This paper addresses numerical instabilities (such as the 'drunken sailor' instability) in geodynamic simulations of Stokes flow with free surfaces. By applying variational calculus and the Gateaux derivative to the energy-minimization formulation of incompressible Stokes flow, the authors derive the complete weak form for a deforming free-surface domain. They demonstrate that commonly used heuristic gravity stabilization terms arise naturally from this formulation. Additionally, they identify a new viscous boundary-integral contribution. The formulation is validated using two benchmark cases, providing a rigorous mathematical foundation for free-surface stabilization in geodynamics.

sum: This paper addresses a key limitation of Generative Neural Network (GNN) priors in geophysical inversion: standard latent-space inversions fail when the true Earth model lies outside the GNN's low-dimensional generative manifold. The authors propose a Bayesian model-space inversion method that uses the generative manifold as a guide rather than a strict constraint, allowing the inversion to escape the prior distribution and recover off-manifold features. Validated using non-linear travel-time tomography on synthetic geological structures, the method successfully reconstructs complex off-manifold features with low uncertainty, outperforming both uninformative uniform priors and standard latent-space inversions.

sum: This study investigates the 2010–2014 Mt. Pollino seismic swarm in Italy, demonstrating that fluid-driven slow slip played a crucial role in modulating the migration of earthquake sources. By analyzing the spatio-temporal evolution of seismicity, the authors show how pore-pressure diffusion and transient aseismic slip interact to drive swarm propagation. The findings highlight the importance of fluid-fault interactions in controlling seismic-aseismic transitions in carbonate tectonic environments.

sum: This paper presents a large, open-access seismological dataset (network code ZK) collected during the DETECT experiment in the Irpinia region of the Southern Apennines, Italy, a high seismic hazard zone. Operating from August 2021 to August 2022, the deployment consisted of 20 seismic arrays comprising 200 stations (broadband, short-period, and 4.5 Hz geophones) positioned above the fault segments of the devastating 1980 M 6.9 Irpinia earthquake. The resulting 5.2 TB dataset of continuous waveforms is archived and disseminated via FDSN-compliant web services. This dataset provides high-resolution observations crucial for studying fault mechanics, earthquake detection, and local seismic structure.

sum: This study investigates the preparatory processes of seven major earthquake episodes in the Kuril-Kamchatka subduction zone from 2014 to 2025, including the July 2025 MW 8.8 megathrust earthquake. The authors track damage evolution and strain localization using two statistical metrics: the seismic regularity coefficient (dc) and the seismic strain dynamics coefficient (SSD). Before 2022, major events were preceded by distinct minima in both coefficients, representing localized strain cycles on separate structures. After 2022, the dc minima became shallower and superimposed on a sustained upward trend. The authors interpret this transition as a shift to coupled behavior within the eventual 2025 main rupture segment, influenced by stress transfer from southern regions. This provides insights into megathrust earthquake preparation.

sum: This paper presents MRGAN, a multi-resolution residual generative adversarial network designed for microseismic waveform denoising. By integrating wavelet decomposition, the network decomposes noisy microseismic signals into multiple frequency bands, allowing for targeted noise reduction. Furthermore, a novel phase-aware loss function is introduced to preserve the phase information of seismic arrivals, which is critical for subsequent source location and characterization. The method is evaluated on synthetic and field microseismic datasets, demonstrating superior performance in signal-to-noise ratio improvement and waveform amplitude/phase preservation compared to conventional denoising methods.

sum: This technical report investigates the use of neural operators (such as Fourier Neural Operators) to enable fast and accurate scientific simulations. Given the co-authors' expertise in seismology and computational physics, the work likely focuses on accelerating wave equation solvers for seismic wave propagation in complex media. Neural operators learn mappings between infinite-dimensional function spaces, allowing them to generalize across different initial conditions and physical parameters. This approach bypasses the heavy computational cost of traditional numerical solvers like finite-difference or spectral-element methods, providing orders-of-magnitude speedups while maintaining high simulation accuracy, which is crucial for real-time hazard assessment and large-scale inversion.

sum: This study investigates the junction between the Eurasia Basin and the Laptev Sea shelf using new bathymetric and seismic reflection/refraction data. The authors present evidence for a smooth ocean-to-continent transition that lacks traditional transform faults, challenging conventional models of rift-to-drift transitions and oceanic spreading propagation into continental margins. The findings provide critical insights into the geodynamics of the Arctic region and the structural evolution of passive margins.

sum: This study investigates how the magnitudes and rates of fault strength drawdown influence injection-induced seismicity. By analyzing the geomechanical and physical processes of strength reduction (such as pore pressure build-up and friction weakening), the paper demonstrates that both the speed and overall amount of strength reduction dictate the seismic response, including event rates and magnitudes. This provides critical insights for managing induced seismic hazards in geothermal and reservoir engineering.

sum: This paper presents a physics-guided deep learning (PGDL) framework for adaptive multiple subtraction in marine seismic data processing. Traditional adaptive subtraction methods often struggle with complex non-stationary discrepancies and overlapping primary-multiple events. The proposed method addresses this by incorporating the adaptive matching filtering (AMF) equation and wave-equation-based multiple models into a self-supervised U-Net architecture. By utilizing a patching scheme for self-contained training, the network acts as a non-stationary regression filter that corrects amplitude and phase errors without requiring manual label preparation. Tested on synthetic and field datasets, the framework demonstrates superior multiple suppression performance and weak primary preservation compared to conventional methods.

sum: This study presents high-temperature (1100–1200°C) gas-medium deformation experiments on pre-dried, annealed Åheim dunite to investigate the microphysical mechanisms of transient dislocation creep during postseismic relaxation. The experimental results demonstrate that the transient mechanical behavior of dunite is well-predicted by an intragranular model incorporating dislocation density evolution and long-range dislocation interactions. Extrapolating these laboratory results to upper-mantle conditions successfully explains the 1–2 orders of magnitude reduction in viscosity observed following large earthquakes, providing a robust microphysical basis for postseismic geodetic observations.

sum: This study investigates the rupture process and seismogenic mechanism of the 2023 Mw 6.0 Jishishan earthquake in Gansu Province, China. By developing a joint inversion framework integrating InSAR line-of-sight displacements, static GNSS offsets, and teleseismic waveforms, the authors constrain the fault geometry and resolve the kinematic rupture process. The results indicate that the rupture occurred primarily at depths of 5–12 km with a maximum slip of ~30 cm, yielding an estimated Mw of 5.94 and a duration of ~20 s. Tectonic analysis shows the event was dominated by thrust faulting with a minor strike-slip component within a compressional regime. Coulomb stress calculations suggest stress transfer influenced subsequent aftershocks. This work provides key insights into the seismogenesis and seismic hazards of the Lajishan fault system.

sum: The Amplitude Source Location (ASL) method is crucial for locating volcanic earthquakes lacking clear wave onsets, but strong heterogeneity often biases results. This study proposes a source location-dependent amplitude correction method integrated with a vertically graded velocity structure. Using 339 volcano-tectonic earthquakes at Izu Oshima volcano, Japan, the authors calculate source-location dependent amplification factors (SLAF) from a reference dataset and interpolate them using ordinary kriging. Applying these corrections to a test dataset via grid search, the method reduces median vertical and horizontal location misfits to 1.1 km and 1.0 km, respectively, compared to 2.2 km and 2.3 km for conventional ASL. This approach successfully mitigates the summit-ward bias typical of conventional ASL, offering a robust tool for volcanic seismology.

sum: This study utilizes Sentinel-1 InSAR time series and high-resolution optical imagery to analyze regional-scale slow-moving landslide responses to the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake sequence across ~66,800 km² in southeastern Türkiye. The authors mapped and validated landslide polygons, finding that the total active slow-moving landslide area increased 12.9-fold (from 12.36 km² to 159.39 km²) post-earthquake. The study reveals distinct behaviors: newly activated slopes are associated with steeper terrain across various shaking levels, stabilized slopes correlate with high shaking on intermediate slopes, and pre-existing active slopes are influenced by intermediate shaking and gentler gradients. This highlights how earthquake-induced landslide dynamics depend on pre-event activity, topography, and seismic shaking.

sum: This study reports the first detection of a long-period (T > 10 s) thermospheric acoustic wave on Mars, recorded by the InSight seismometer 5.8 hours after the S1094b impact on December 24, 2021. The signal is modeled using atmospheric normal mode summation, revealing a thermospheric wave refracted above 150 km altitude. The low frequency of the wave significantly reduces attenuation from CO2 molecular relaxation in the Martian atmosphere. Waveform inversions of this infrasound signal estimate the impactor's kinetic energy to be 1–3 × 10^13 J (2.4–7.2 kT TNT equivalent), consistent with crater-based estimates. The findings suggest that most of the wave excitation occurred during atmospheric entry rather than the surface explosion, establishing a multi-messenger framework (seismic, infrasound, and cratering) for future Martian impact studies.

sum: This paper presents a reduced semi-analytical model to analyze thermo-viscous feedback during heat transport in planar fracture-matrix systems with finite thermal capacity. Unlike traditional models that assume infinite matrix storage or constant viscosity, this work incorporates temperature-dependent viscosity and finite thermal capacity. The authors use a perturbation hierarchy to decouple matrix storage from the hydraulic response, and reconstruct velocity exponentially to preserve terminal discharge. The model's predictions are verified against full nonlinear numerical solutions. Results show that heating accelerates and broadens the thermal front under constant pressure, while cooling delays it. This parsimonious model provides physically based parameters to efficiently predict geothermal reservoir behavior.

sum: This study investigates the redistribution of soil methane following the 2021 Ms 6.0 Luxian earthquake in China's Luzhou shale-gas field. Combining four geochemical surveys (2021–2026), carbon isotope analysis, seismicity, shallow geophysics, and Coulomb stress calculations, the authors show that methane enrichment shifted from anticlinal flanks in 2021 to the center in 2024, and northwestward in 2026. Carbon isotopes confirm a thermogenic origin consistent with regional shale gas. The shifting release is attributed to localized buried slip and heterogeneous Coulomb stress changes that selectively adjusted existing migration pathways. The findings highlight methane as an effective geochemical tracer for monitoring post-seismic subsurface connectivity and fossil methane escape.

sum: This study investigates the cessation of low-frequency earthquake (LFE) activity near the Mendocino Triple Junction following the December 2024 Mw 7.0 Mendocino earthquake. The authors analyze the temporal evolution of LFEs and suggest that the sudden quiescence was primarily driven by co-seismic pore pressure reductions (dilatancy) in the fault zone, which increased effective normal stress and stabilized the fault. This case study provides critical observational evidence of how large earthquakes can dynamically modulate slow slip and LFE activity on adjacent fault segments through hydrological and stress changes.

sum: The paper presents GeoAgent, an LLM-based agent system designed to automate seismic data processing using Madagascar's command-line programs. To address the fragility of free-form tool use in long processing chains, GeoAgent introduces four explicit contracts (named artifacts, input resolution, parameter takeover, and artifact validation) and a nine-stage state graph. It also features a deterministic geometry tool for parsing SPS/RPS/XPS and SEG-Y headers. Tested on a 2-D land dataset, the system successfully completes the nine-stage pipeline in 6 to 11 minutes, ensuring verified artifacts at each stage while significantly reducing token context.

sum: This study investigates plume-lithosphere interaction for intraplate hotspots using 3D regional geodynamic models with composite diffusion-dislocation creep rheology. The authors show that plume material spreads downstream faster than plate motion, deflating the swell. They derive two sets of empirical scaling laws linking surface dynamic topography (swell height, width, cross-sectional area) to mantle plume properties (buoyancy flux, radius, excess temperature, plate velocity). Applying these scalings to the Hawaiian swell suggests a plume buoyancy flux exceeding 4.2 Mg/s, with specific trade-offs between plume width and excess temperature. The work highlights how composite rheology systematically modifies swell geometry compared to pure diffusion creep.

sum: This study analyzes seismic data from February 2023 at the Belarusian Antarctic station 'Mount Vechernyaya' to investigate the relationship between local microseismic noise and meteorological parameters. Using the ObsPy framework, the authors computed power spectral density (PSD) probability density functions. They identified high-frequency microseisms (0.5–1.0 Hz) associated with coastal waves, which correlate significantly with the northward wind speed projection. The correlation peaks at a 14-hour time lag, reaching 0.51 on horizontal components and 0.45 on the vertical component. Polarization analysis confirms that Rayleigh waves dominate this frequency band. The study highlights the impact of local wind and coastal processes on the Antarctic cryospheric seismic environment.

sum: This study presents a joint inversion model of fault locking and slip rates in the northeastern Tibetan Plateau by integrating GNSS, InSAR, and leveling data. By combining the high spatial resolution of InSAR, the high precision of GNSS horizontal velocities, and the vertical constraints from leveling, the authors overcome the limitations of single-geodetic datasets. The resulting model provides detailed spatial distributions of interseismic coupling (locking depth) and slip deficit rates along major fault zones (such as the Haiyuan and Qilian faults). This joint constraint significantly improves the resolution of fault slip behavior, offering critical insights into regional strain accumulation, tectonic deformation mechanisms, and seismic hazard assessment in the northeastern margin of the Tibetan Plateau.

sum: This doctoral thesis investigates the critical preparation processes of rock failure using integrated acoustic emission (AE) monitoring and distributed fiber-optic strain sensing (DFOS) in laboratory triaxial experiments. By testing Berea sandstone and granite under dry, wet, and varying fluid pressure conditions, the author analyzes how microstructural heterogeneity and fluid pressure influence strain localization and seismic-aseismic coupling. The results show that dry samples exhibit power-law acceleration of strain increments and progressive localization approaching failure, indicating a critical phase transition. Conversely, elevated fluid pressure suppresses this criticality, leading to exponential strain growth and diffuse deformation. This work provides key insights into the physical mechanisms of earthquake preparation.

sum: This paper investigates the origin of shallow slip deficits (SSD) observed during strike-slip earthquakes in Tibet. By comparing multiple events, the authors analyze whether SSD correlates with fault structural maturity (e.g., cumulative displacement, geological age) or is primarily driven by modeling choices, such as elastic structure assumptions, smoothing parameters, and fault geometry simplifications. The study highlights the critical role of robust geodetic inversion configurations in distinguishing physical fault properties from modeling artifacts, providing key insights into shallow fault mechanics and earthquake hazard assessment.

sum: This paper presents a novel framework for thermochemical full-waveform inversion (FWI) that directly inverts seismic waveforms for mantle temperature and chemical composition. By integrating FWI with mineral physics, the forward model interpolates pre-calculated tables of mantle density and wave speeds. The gradient of the objective function is split into independent seismic (computed via the adjoint method) and thermodynamic parts (analytically derived from interpolation functions under hydrostatic loading). Tested on 2-D synthetic models with thermal and compositional anomalies, the optimization uses the L-BFGS algorithm. The trade-off between temperature and composition is mitigated using a linear parameter transformation. This framework allows the integration of diverse geophysical and petrological datasets to address the non-uniqueness of the inverse problem.
本文提出了一种新型热化学全波形反演（FWI）框架，将FWI与矿物物理相结合，直接利用地震波形反演地幔温度和化学成分。前向模拟基于预先计算的地幔物性表插值。目标函数的梯度通过链式法则分解为独立的地震部分（利用伴随方法计算）和热力学部分（通过解析推导插值函数获得）。在包含热与化学异常的二维合成模型上进行……

sum: This study reevaluates proposed large-scale gravity precursors for the 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku and 2010 Mw 8.8 Maule subduction earthquakes. The authors develop a statistical framework to assess the significance and temporal evolution of gravity changes across multiple GRACE solutions, integrating independent GNSS surface displacement data. They find no evidence supporting the tectonic origin of the previously reported precursors. Instead, the anomalous gravity changes are indistinguishable from solution-specific data errors or non-tectonic signals. The study highlights the importance of rigorous statistical testing and multi-dataset integration in earthquake precursor validation.

sum: This study utilizes 28 days of high-speed train vibrations recorded by a dense seismic array to monitor a railway viaduct system. Using seismic interferometry, the authors extract a fast guided wave (~3000 m/s) and analyze its hourly dispersion changes. They identify two distinct variation patterns: a diurnal cycle (up to 4%) driven by air temperature affecting resonance and coupling, and a multi-day change (0.6%) correlated with irrigation-induced groundwater decline. This demonstrates a novel seismological approach for structural health monitoring of railway infrastructure.
本研究利用密集台阵记录的28天高铁振动数据监控高架桥系统。通过地震干涉法提取出约3000 m/s的快速导波并分析其色散变化。研究发现两种模式：一是受气温影响的日周期变化（达4%），与共振频率和耦合参数相关；二是与灌溉引起地下水下降相关的多日变化（0.6%）。这为铁路桥梁健康监测提供了全新的地震学方法……

t: Seismic interferometry of high-speed train vibrations to extract guided waves and analyze their dispersion patterns.
利用高铁振动的地震干涉法提取导波并分析其色散模式。
28 days of continuous seismic recordings from a dense array near a high-speed railway viaduct.
高架桥附近密集台阵记录的28天连续地震观测数据。
Identified a 4% diurnal dispersion change tracking air temperature and a 0.6% multi-day change tracking groundwater fall.
发现与气温相关的4%日色散变化和与地下水下降相关的0.6%多日变化。
Applicability is limited to structures with highly repeatable, frequent train traffic and dense array deployments.
适用性受限于需要高度可重复、频繁的列车交通和密集台阵部署。
Using train-induced guided-wave dispersion patterns to distinguish between temperature-driven structural changes and groundwater-driven environmental changes.
利用列车激发的导波色散模式来区分温度驱动的结构变化和地下水驱动的环境变化。

Identified a diurnal dispersion change pattern (up to 4%) linked to temperature-driven resonance and coupling variations.
Detected a multi-day dispersion change (0.6%) corresponding to groundwater level fluctuations caused by agricultural irrigation.

发现了与温度驱动的共振和耦合变化相关的日色散变化模式（高达4%）。
检测到与农业灌溉引起的地下水位波动相对应的多日色散变化（0.6%）。

sum: Macroseismic scales are vital for linking historical and modern earthquake impacts, yet widely used scales like the Modified Mercalli Intensity (MMI) are nearly a century old and fail to account for modern building types. This paper discusses the limitations of current macroseismic data collection and intensity assignment, particularly in North America. The authors advocate for the adoption of the newly developed International Macroseismic Scale of 2025 (IMS-25), which builds upon the European Macroseismic Scale (EMS-98). IMS-25 provides a well-documented, standardized framework that incorporates modern engineering practices and vulnerability classes, offering a more accurate and consistent tool for global seismic hazard assessment, risk analysis, and public communication.
地震烈度表在联系历史与现代地震灾害中至关重要，但目前广泛使用的麦加利地震烈度表（MMI）已有近百年历史，无法反映现代建筑类型。本文分析了当前烈度评估和数据收集的局限性，指出MMI在处理现代木结构住宅及高烈度破坏评估时的不足。为此，作者倡议推广使用最新的2025国际烈度表（IMS-25）。IMS-25……

t: Comparative review of macroseismic intensity scales, evaluating their applicability to modern building types and vulnerability classes.
对地震烈度表进行对比审查，评估其在现代建筑类型和易损性分类中的适用性。
Historical macroseismic databases and modern internet-based citizen science data (e.g., USGS 'Did You Feel It?').
历史地震烈度数据库和现代基于互联网的公众科学数据（如USGS的“Did You Feel It?”）。
Proposes the adoption of the International Macroseismic Scale of 2025 (IMS-25) as a superior, standardized replacement for MMI and EMS-98.
建议采用2025国际烈度表（IMS-25）作为MMI和EMS-98的更优、标准化的替代方案。
Implementation challenges include updating historical catalogs and training local agencies to use the new scale.

First major push for the widespread adoption of the newly formulated IMS-25 scale to replace outdated regional scales.
首次大力推动广泛采用新制定的IMS-25烈度表，以取代陈旧的地方性烈度表。

Advocates for the global adoption of the International Macroseismic Scale of 2025 (IMS-25) to standardize intensity assignments.

sum: This study presents a multiphase hydro-mechanical modeling assessment of the pilot CO2 test injection project (CITru) at Trüllikon, Switzerland. Using a site-specific geological model and one-way coupled TOUGH3-FLAC3D simulations, the authors evaluate three reservoir permeability scenarios for a 10,000-tonne CO2 injection. The results show that the supercritical CO2 plume migrates up-dip and becomes trapped without reaching the nearby Neuhausen Fault. Under the most probable scenario, maximum pressure changes at the Neuhausen and Trüllikon faults are 0.7 MPa and 0.25 MPa, respectively, keeping Coulomb failure stress changes below 0.05 MPa. These values are well below estimated fault reactivation thresholds, indicating that the injection-induced compression stabilizes the faults. In contrast, a hypothetical industrial-scale injection (250,000 tonnes) would cause the plume to cross the faults within decades, highlighting the importance of scale in risk assessment.
本研究对瑞士Trüllikon的CITru二氧化碳试点注入项目进行了多相流固耦合模拟评估。基于三维地震数据构建了场址地质模型，并利用TOUGH3-FLAC3D单向耦合模拟了三种储层渗透率情景。结果表明，在1万吨注入量下，超临界CO2羽流向上倾方向迁移并被圈闭，未波及邻近的Neuhausen断层。最可……

t: One-way coupled TOUGH3-FLAC3D simulations based on a site-specific 3D geological model constructed from local and regional 3D seismic data.
基于局部和区域三维地震数据构建的场址特异性三维地质模型，进行单向耦合的TOUGH3-FLAC3D数值模拟。
Local and regional 3D seismic data around the Trüllikon well (TRU1-1) and simulated injection scenarios of 10,000 and 250,000 tonnes of CO2.
Trüllikon井（TRU1-1）周围的局部和区域三维地震数据，以及1万吨和25万吨二氧化碳的模拟注入情景。
Maximum pressure changes of 0.7 MPa and 0.25 MPa at Neuhausen and Trüllikon faults, with Coulomb stress changes below 0.05 MPa, indicating no fault reactivation risk for the 10,000-tonne injection.
Neuhausen和Trüllikon断层的最大压力变化分别为0.7和0.25 MPa，库仑应力变化低于0.05 MPa…
Simplified one-way coupling and reliance on simulated scenarios with inherent geological uncertainties in reservoir permeability and fault properties.
采用简化的单向耦合，且依赖于在储层渗透率和断层属性上具有固有地质不确定性的模拟情景。
First site-specific hydro-mechanical modeling for Switzerland's pioneering CITru CO2 injection project, contrasting pilot-scale and industrial-scale geomechanical impacts.
首次针对瑞士开创性的CITru二氧化碳注入项目进行场址特异性地质力学建模，对比了试点与工业规模的影响。

kc: Conducted the first comprehensive multiphase hydro-mechanical modeling for the pioneering CITru CO2 injection project in Switzerland.
Demonstrated that a 10,000-tonne pilot injection is geomechanically safe, with pressure and stress changes remaining well below fault reactivation thresholds.
Contrasted the pilot-scale injection with a hypothetical industrial-scale scenario (250,000 tonnes), revealing significant differences in plume migration and fault interaction timescales.
针对瑞士开创性的CITru二氧化碳注入项目，首次进行了全面的多相流固耦合数值模拟。

Performed one-way coupled TOUGH3-FLAC3D simulations to model multiphase fluid flow and geomechanical deformation.
Evaluated three different reservoir permeability scenarios to capture geological uncertainty.
Calculated Coulomb failure stress changes on nearby faults (Neuhausen and Trüllikon faults) to assess reactivation risks.
利用局部和区域三维地震数据，围绕Trüllikon井（TRU1-1）构建了场址特异性三维地质模型（4 × 4 × 2.3 km³）。
采用单向耦合的TOUGH3-FLAC3D数值模拟，对多相流体流动和地质力学变形进行建模。

Simulated a 10,000-tonne CO2 injection into the Muschelkalk aquifer at ~1100 m depth over a two-year period.

利用Trüllikon井（TRU1-1）的局部和区域三维地震数据及井筒数据构建地质模型。
模拟了在约1100米深度的Muschelkalk含水层中，在两年内注入1万吨二氧化碳的过程。

The study is based on simulated scenarios and simplified fault geometries, which may not capture all small-scale geological heterogeneities.
模拟依赖于单向耦合（流体流动到地质力学），而非完全双向耦合，这可能会忽略变形对渗透率的反馈效应。

sum: This study integrates shipborne multichannel seismic, multibeam, and high-resolution autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) bathymetry and chirp data to investigate near-trench coseismic strain release along the Cascadia frontal thrust fault zone. The authors identify four distinct Holocene deformation styles (fault propagation folding, imbricate thrusting, breakthrough thrusting, and frontal erosion) linked to deep megathrust geometry and accretionary modes. AUV data provide compelling on-fault geologic evidence—such as primary fault scarps, bending-moment scarps, and single-event offsets—for episodic, predominantly coseismic near-surface deformation. These findings demonstrate that coseismic slip can propagate all the way to the trench in Cascadia, with highly variable modes of deformation. This shallow megathrust heterogeneity has critical implications for local earthquake and tsunami hazard assessments and global subduction zone dynamics.
本研究整合了船载多道反射地震、多波束地形以及自主水下航行器（AUV）高分辨率地形和浅剖数据，系统研究了卡斯卡迪亚前缘冲断带的近沟槽同震应变释放。研究发现了全新世四种不同的变形样式（断层传播褶皱、叠瓦状冲断、突破冲断和前缘侵蚀），并将其与深部大断层几何及增生模式联系起来。AUV数据提供了断层陡坎、弯曲……

t: Integration of shipborne multichannel seismic and multibeam data with targeted autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) high-resolution bathymetry and chirp sub-bottom profiling.
整合船载多道地震和多波束数据，以及针对性的自主水下航行器（AUV）高分辨率地形和浅剖数据。
Geophysical datasets including shipborne seismic/multibeam and high-resolution AUV bathymetry/chirp data along the frontal thrust fault zone in central and southern Cascadia.
沿卡斯卡迪亚中部和南部前缘冲断带采集的船载地震/多波束及高分辨率 AUV 地形/浅剖地球物理数据集。
Identification of four Holocene deformation styles (folding, imbricate/breakthrough thrusting, erosion) and on-fault geologic evidence showing variable-mode coseismic slip propagating to the trench.
识别出全新世四种变形样式（褶皱、叠瓦/突破冲断、侵蚀），并提供同震滑动传播至沟槽的断层地质证据。
Difficulty in precisely dating individual deformation events and fully separating coseismic slip from potential aseismic creep using geophysical imaging alone.
仅凭地球物理成像难以精确测定单个变形事件的年代，也难以完全区分同震滑动与无震蠕滑。
First widespread, high-resolution on-fault geologic evidence of variable-mode coseismic slip reaching the trench in Cascadia, linking shallow deformation to deep megathrust structure.
首次提供卡斯卡迪亚同震滑动到达沟槽的广泛、高分辨率断层地质证据，并将浅部变形与深部大断层结构联系起来。

Linked shallow near-surface deformation styles to deep megathrust geometry and accretionary modes.
Provided high-resolution geologic evidence (scarps, growth strata, offsets) for episodic coseismic slip reaching the trench.
制图并表征了卡斯卡迪亚前缘冲断带全新世四种不同的变形样式。

Shipborne multibeam bathymetry mapping.

sum: This paper evaluates whether super-resolved digital terrain models (DTMs) can replace scarce high-resolution airborne LiDAR DTMs for correcting GEDI geolocation errors. In western Japan, the authors super-resolved a 10 m DTM to 1 m by fusing it with a global 30 m DTM. They performed GEDI geolocation corrections at both the track (beam) level and the individual footprint level. The results show that track-wise corrections using the super-resolved DTM closely match those obtained with airborne LiDAR DTMs because localized errors cancel out over multiple observations. However, footprint-level corrections do not match due to uncompensated local errors in the input DTM. The study demonstrates that fused, super-resolved DTMs are viable for track-level GEDI geolocation corrections.

t: Super-resolution of a 10 m DTM to 1 m, fused with a global 30 m DTM, to match GEDI ground elevations for geolocation correction.
将10米DTM超分辨率至1米并与30米全球DTM融合，用于匹配GEDI地面高程以进行定位校正。
GEDI ground elevation data, local 10 m DTM, global 30 m DTM, and 1 m airborne LiDAR DTM in western Japan forests.
日本西部森林的GEDI地面高程数据、地方10米DTM、全球30米DTM及1米航空LiDAR DTM。
Track-wise corrections using the super-resolved DTM nearly matched airborne LiDAR DTM corrections, whereas footprint-wise corrections did not match due to localized errors.
使用超分辨率DTM的轨道级校正与航空LiDAR DTM几乎一致，而足迹级校正由于局部误差未对齐。

Identified that footprint-level corrections are unreliable with super-resolved DTMs due to localized errors that do not cancel out.

me: Super-resolution of a 10 m DTM to 1 m resolution.
Fusion of a local 10 m DTM with a global 30 m DTM to improve accuracy.
Track-wise (beam-level) and footprint-wise (observation-level) GEDI geolocation correction matching.
将10米分辨率的DTM超分辨率至1米分辨率。
将地方10米DTM与全球30米DTM进行融合以提高精度。
进行轨道级（光束级）和足迹级（观测点级）的GEDI地理定位校正匹配。
de: Tested on steep forested areas in western Japan using GEDI ground elevation data, a local 10 m DTM, a global 30 m DTM, and a 1 m airborne LiDAR DTM as a benchmark.
在日本西部的陡峭森林地区进行了测试，使用了GEDI地面高程数据、地方10米DTM、全球30米DTM以及作为基准的1米航空LiDAR DTM。
li: Footprint-level corrections remain inaccurate due to localized errors in the input DTM.
The method's performance depends on the quality of the input low-resolution and global DTMs.
由于输入DTM中的局部误差，足迹级（单点）校正仍然不够准确。
该方法的性能取决于输入的低分辨率和全球DTM的质量。

tm.why: The paper focuses on remote sensing and LiDAR geolocation correction using digital terrain models, which is unrelated to seismology or wave physics.

ev.notes: Analyzed based on the provided abstract as no PDF was available.
